title: TissueConnect
description: A predictive-analytics platform for spinal disease diagnostics. Led architecture end-to-end - backend services, database schemas, and secure Azure cloud infrastructure with Key Vault encryption for HIPAA-aligned clinical MRI data. Built the muscle-analysis and MRI-segmentation pipelines behind it.

title: Biddaan
description: A multi-tenant SaaS education platform for online classes and course management. Designed and automated Nginx reverse-proxy configuration for the multi-tenant architecture, plus report generation, analytics, and a course-preview feature.

title: AI Mate
description: A GPT-powered mobile chatbot. Architected type-safe REST APIs from OpenAPI specifications and built the complete admin dashboard for chatbot configuration, user management, and analytics, supporting 50,000 users.

title: Daency
description: An online group-dance platform with real-time, interactive classes for international clients. Integrated WebRTC for live video, Stripe for payments, and Redis-based event-driven task queues, supporting 500+ concurrent users across 30+ live classes.

title: Bikribatta
description: An inventory-management SaaS for SMEs, built from the ground up - accounts, reporting, and employee management. Spearheaded the migration from Backbone.js to Vue 3.

title: Project management
description: A project-management web app for Sheraspace's interior-design platform, engineered from scratch - account management, HR modules, and reporting with advanced PostgreSQL queries and Chart.js visualizations.

title: Daily stocks
description: A push-notification service delivering daily updates from the Dhaka Stock Exchange.
